invariants.rationale: A valid instantTime (commit time) is required for a delete operation.
There must be some keys to delete; the operation is only meaningful if keys is non-null and non-empty.
A non-null HoodieEngineContext is required for distributed execution and IO operations.
HoodieWriteConfig is needed for configuration lookup during the delete operation.
The HoodieTable reference is required to perform table-related actions such as index lookup and deduplication.
